rationale: PCT01 flagged the CIK-quarter pct_of_net_assets sum at about 200.02%, but the raw schedule itself prints Total Investments fair value of 340,357,403 as 200.02% of Net Assets, and the balance sheet shows Net Assets of 170,165,477. The schedule also prints liabilities in excess of other assets as (100.02)% and Net Assets as 100.00%, so the aggregate above 100% is an expected leveraged BDC presentation rather than an extracted data error.
